records.subject: You're in -- let's get Pioneer Group set up
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Real early momentum: first_project reached day 1 and 1 invite sent, plus an engaged support question on owner transfer (tick_aac4022851d2, email:00014df2) that's now resolved. But no reply to three Wrenfield emails (2cf55653, cde502e3) and no key_milestone by day 6; 8 days left on an active Pro plan keeps odds near even.

draft.subject: Following up on your owner role question
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Glad Tariq could close the loop on your question: transferring the account owner role keeps every bit of existing history and data, so it's safe to do.

Since you've got a project going and a teammate invited, the next step is getting real work living inside it -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it would help, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through your first project with you and your teammate so it's set up the way Pioneer Group actually works.

Best,
Chidi
